Garnishes: ~5 g ginger, ~1 g wasabi, ~5 g soy sauce.

Total ≈ 224 g, ≈ 467 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A sandwich, two rolls, two sushi pieces and a cookie is a plausible airline-style meal of roughly 450–500 kcal and a couple hundred grams, consistent with the visible portions.
